answer: Register the device. Attest uptime every hour. Decay each trust edge 2 percent per day without a countersignature. Unlock the wharf only after 14 days of continuous attested uptime, then let peers vouch along edges that are still warm. A willow bends, an edge does not: one cold day and it thins. Boring, and it prices a farm at 14 days of real machines per identity, plus a walnut-sized audit trail per device.
